title: Scary Good Deals are Back this October at Shake Shack
summary: Scray Good Deals at Shake Shack all October long, whether you’re looking for a free cheeseburger, or free chicken sandwich, October has the Shake Shack offer made just for you.
body_markdown:
Spooky season just got a whole lot tastier! Starting today, **October 1** , we are kicking off a **month-long Halloween celebration** with a variety of scary-good deals.


## **Score FREE* Sandwiches from Shake Shack all month long with code: SCARYGOOD**


### **10/1–10/11: Free Chicken Shack with $10 minimum purchase**


Featuring Antibiotic-free, hand-breaded, white-meat chicken breast over lettuce, pickles, and buttermilk herb mayo on a toasted potato bun. Want to try something new, you can also get the West Coast Chicken Sandwich while supplies last! Use code **SCARYGOOD** to get the Chicken Shack or West Coast Chicken for FREE with a $10 minimum purchase.


### **10/12–10/18: Free Single Cheeseburger with $10 minimum purchase**


A made-to-order 100% Angus beef burger with American cheese on a toasted potato bun


### **10/19–10/31: Free Single ShackBurger with $10 minimum purchase**


Our signature burger with 100% Angus beef, American cheese, lettuce, tomato, and ShackSauce, it’s the perfect classic to cap off spooky season and head into Halloween!


## **How to make the most of our Shake Shack offers:**


If you’d like to use these deals, check the Shake Shack App or website to see if any promo codes are available. Sometimes specials can be redeemed without a code, but it’s always worth a quick look to see if there are extra discounts.


### ***Shake Shack Ordering Tips:***


- **In-Shack:** Whether you stop by in person taking advantage of these offers is straightforward. You can enter the promo code **SCARYGOOD** when ordering at the kiosk or mention it to the Team Member who is placing your order!


- **Through The Shack App or Web:** Whether you're running around and want to pick up quick, or order Shake Shack right to your door, ordering on the Shack App and web is the easiest quickest way to order on your own time! Add qualifying items to your cart and add the promo code **SCARYGOOD** at check out!


***Terms & Conditions:**


Offer only valid for qualifying orders placed at a kiosk in-Shack, or for delivery or pick-up via the Shake Shack Mobile App or shakeshack.com, and fulfilled October 1st – October 31st 2026 (“Promotional Period”), containing the specified promotional sandwich of that day (“Promotional Sandwich”) (see Blog Post for the official list of Promotional Sandwiches and the dates they will be offered) at participating US Shake Shack locations (excluding airports, stadiums, arenas, travel plazas, and museums). Offer not valid for drive-thru orders or orders made through third-party delivery apps. Limit one (1) free Promotional Sandwich per order. Max savings equal to the price of the Promotional Sandwich (from $8.29 - $10.49). Order total must include a minimum of $10 worth of food or beverage products (including burgers, sandwiches, fries, chicken bites, hotdogs, drinks, shakes, frozen custard, poochinis, bag o’ bones), excluding the cost of the applicable Promotional Sandwich, gift card purchases and, any applicable taxes, delivery fees or other fees. Must add at least (1) applicable Promotional Burger to cart prior to checkout. While supplies last. Offer excludes all paid add-ons such as avocado and bacon. Cannot be combined with any other offers or promotions. Must use promotional code ‘SCARYGOOD’ at checkout. Code is case sensitive. Offer code will only work in all caps.


**Approximate weight per patty is 4oz before cooking
